ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, icons, card borders, structural lines — the default foreground across all body and heading content

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text, inverted foregrounds

whisper.$description: Whisper — Hairline borders, dividers, subtle separators, card outlines

carbon.$description: Carbon — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary dark surfaces, icon strokes, muted dark text on light surfaces

graphite.$description: Graphite — Tertiary text, secondary button borders, subdued labels

ash.$description: Ash — Body secondary text, helper copy, placeholder text

fog.$description: Fog — Disabled controls, very light icon strokes, decorative dot motifs

mist.$description: Mist — Inverted muted foreground — light text on Carbon-filled buttons and dark cards (replaces Paper when on dark surfaces)

indigo-pulse.$description: Indigo Pulse — Saturated category badge fill — the sole chromatic accent on chrome elements, used sparingly to tag template categories

sky-pulse.$description: Sky Pulse — Secondary category badge fill — lighter blue companion to Indigo Pulse for alternating category tags

pp-neue-montreal.$description: The sole typeface across the entire product — body copy at 14px/1.43, UI labels at 12–13px, subheadings at 16–18px, and a single display step at 38px. Weights 400 for body, 500 for navigation/tabs, 600 for the hero headline and button text. The 0.020em positive tracking is signature: it opens the geometric forms slightly so small sizes (10–12px) stay legible without feeling mechanical.

proxima-nova.$description: proxima-nova — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
